test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'travel for fun' is coded as 'dv pa vi';

'fun will begin' is coded as 'cr dv em'

and 'will travel today' is coded as 'vi cr hz'.

(All the codes are two-letter codes only.)

How will 'for today' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] 

**__Mistake Points:__**** In Chinese Coding- Decoding questions the codes for the given words don't need to be placed sequentially, they may be given in jumbled form also.**

So, in these types of questions check the options whether they are in jumbled form or sequence. If the options are jumbled then it is also correct.

The code for each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/066269089189be36fdfbb134d1a339bbef0a8efc90e7104b91aa4f03f192eab0.png] 

Code for words are:

 
• for - pa
 
• today - hz

Clearly, 'for today' will be coded as 'hz pa' in that language.

Hence, '**hz pa**' is the correct answer.
